blocks.text:
Welcome to SNUG STAR store,have a good time!
 SNUG STAR devote ourselves to creating fashion and practical bags, with high quality and good service providing a good experience for the customers.
 If you have any problem,you can contact our customer service,we support return and exchange items.
Feature:
 Durable, can be washed, light, multi-color, fashion bag for women
 It has a lot of storage area. There are many compartments pertaining to every needs and the bag is designed very well. You can store small things to bigger things in different parts of the bag and they will be easy to segregate and find.
 It works great in both casual and more professional settings. Like for working, short traveling, daily life.
 Perfect for everyday using. It can hold your iPad, cell phone, books, umbrella, keys, wallet, sunglasses, lipstick ,facial tissue and other stuffs.
 Notes:
 1.Don’t use hot water and alkaline detergent to wash it.
 2. Hang to dry and store in ventilated place instead of sun exposure.
 3. To avoid staining, please wash separately .
 4. Due to pressure during the transportation, some of the bags could be slightly deformed. The shape will recover after using for a while.
 5.Since the product was shot under the flash of the studio, The color of the product under natural light will have a little color difference. And each brand of monitor will have a difference in viewing product images.
 6.Due to manual measure, it allows 1-2CM discrepancy.

items.label: Material
items.value: Cotton Canvas/ Dimensions: 13.8" L x Bag:13"& Handle: 5.1" H x 4.7" W/ Weight: 0.58 KG

items: Inside there are two pleated pockets and on the opposite side is a large pocket and two zippered pockets on either side of it.
The top of the bag also is zippered and there is one small zipped pocked on the outside of the bag
Very durable,and holds everything you need, including your iPad, cell phone, books(A4), umbrella, keys, wallet, sunglasses, lipstick ,facial tissue and other stuffs.
Removable and adjustable shoulder strap could be used cross body or shoulder. It's also very thick so your shoulders won't hurt while carrying it.

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Hand wash with mild detergent, hang dry, store in ventilated place away from sunlight, wash separately.
